name: Checkbox
summary: Native binary choice control with checked, indeterminate, disabled, required, validation, form-value, hover, and focus-visible behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Label wrapper that owns layout, validation presentation, and the full pointer activation area.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.description: Native input with type checkbox that owns selection, keyboard, form, required, and disabled semantics.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible label text associated by the wrapping label element.

anatomy.name: requiredIndicator
anatomy.description: Decorative asterisk optically centered with the choice label when checked consent is required.

anatomy.name: checkedIndicator
anatomy.description: Generated Lucide Check geometry shown by the native checked state.

anatomy.name: indeterminateIndicator
anatomy.description: Generated Lucide Minus geometry shown by the native indeterminate property.

variants.name: error
variants.description: Invalid choice presentation using the shared Error field hierarchy.

variants.name: success
variants.description: Successful validation presentation using the shared Success field hierarchy.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: Attention state for a choice that remains valid using the shared Warning field hierarchy.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One 20px control centered on the first 24px line of 16px label text; the wrapping label supplies the larger activation area.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover across the full label area; validation variants preserve their semantic border family.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus state using the shared 4px field ring with no offset.

states.name: checked
states.description: Selected native state with a generated check indicator.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: Mixed native state with a generated minus indicator.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable native control and label presentation.

states.name: errorFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Error variant with the lighter Error outer ring.

states.name: successFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Success variant with the lighter Success outer ring.

states.name: warningFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Warning variant with the lighter Warning outer ring.

behavior.name: nativeSelection
behavior.description: Pointer activation, label activation, and Space use native checkbox selection behavior.

behavior.name: selectionOwnership
attributes: checked content attribute establishes defaultChecked in static HTML
checked IDL property represents live selection
indeterminate IDL property represents live mixed presentation
behavior.description: Static HTML remains natively uncontrolled after its initial checkedness. Framework adapters may bind checked and indeterminate live properties with native events for controlled use without introducing a second selection owner.

behavior.name: labelAssociation
behavior.description: The visible label is the checkbox's accessible name and full activation target.

behavior.name: formValue
behavior.description: The native control owns successful form submission and reset behavior.

behavior.name: indeterminateState
attributes: data-indeterminate="true" maps to the native indeterminate property
events: change clears the initial data-indeterminate marker
behavior.description: The shared enhancer initializes native mixed state without replacing checkbox semantics.

behavior.name: nativeDisabled
behavior.description: Unavailable controls use native disabled focus, activation, and form behavior.

behavior.name: nativeRequired
behavior.description: Required binary choices participate in native form constraint validation.

behavior.name: validationSemantics
attributes: aria-describedby references feedback owned by Field Wrapper when present
behavior.description: Checkbox owns validation presentation and native invalid state while Field Wrapper owns associated feedback content.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible accessible label for the binary choice.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Value submitted with the native name when checked.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation selected independently from the native checked state.

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Represents native selection; static web markup establishes initial checkedness while controlled adapters bind the live checked property.

properties.name: indeterminate
properties.description: Initial mixed state synchronized by progressive enhancement; controlled adapters bind the live native indeterminate property.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Participates in native required-choice constraint validation and shows the standardized decorative marker beside the choice label.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id reference for helper or validation feedback owned by a surrounding Field Wrapper.

accessibility: Use a native input with type="checkbox" for keyboard, form, constraint-validation, and assistive-technology behavior.
Associate a visible label by wrapping the input or using matching for/id attributes.
Use checked, required, disabled, name, and value on the native input rather than duplicating their behavior.
Use native indeterminate for mixed state; data-indeterminate is only its progressive initialization contract.
Treat checked and indeterminate as independent native properties: indeterminate wins visually while form submission still follows checked.
Use the wrapping label as the full pointer target and preserve at least the 24px label line box around the 20px visual control.
Use aria-invalid="true" only for Error and aria-describedby for associated feedback from Field Wrapper.
Do not communicate validation or selection through color alone; checked and indeterminate retain distinct generated indicators.
Preserve native checkbox appearance in forced-colors mode.

web.notes: Canonical CSS styles native states and shared theme.js initializes data-indeterminate; static HTML remains uncontrolled after initial checkedness.

shopify.notes: Shopify renders native checkbox markup and the shared theme.js progressively initializes mixed state.

react.notes: A future adapter binds checked and indeterminate live properties with native input/change events or supplies uncontrolled initial values.
